description: Expander for Mortuus, placed immediately to its right: it gives each of the four parameter knobs a control voltage jack and an attenuverter, with a second set of four for channel 2 in expert mode

params.text: Attenuverts the voltage at the jack for the same parameter, setting how far and in which direction it moves that Mortuus parameter
Attenuverts the voltage at the jack for the same parameter of channel 2, setting how far and in which direction it moves it

inputs.text: Adds to that parameter on Mortuus, 5V at full attenuverter covering the whole range of the matching knob; while a cable is patched here the jack sets the parameter and the Mortuus knob is ignored
Adds to the same parameter of channel 2 on Mortuus, 5V at full attenuverter covering the whole range of the matching knob; it is read only while Mortuus is in expert mode

notes: the expander does nothing on its own: it has to be placed immediately to the right of an Mortuus module, and a lamp on each of the two modules lights when the pair is made.
the four jacks for channel 2 are read only while the paired Mortuus is in expert mode; in twin and in split they are ignored.
the lamp beside each jack of the first four reports which channel that parameter is currently reaching, and the lamp at the head of each column reports whether the column is active.
